presentation.label: PassiveSkill02
omissions: Manual visual callback selection; no native combat modifier or automatic event simulation.

event: 0=Weakness break, 1=Weakness break update, 2=Bleed, 3=Frozen update, 4=Frozen pulse, 5=MCommon_Element_Frozen: OnDestroy, 6=Frozen effect, 7=Burn, 8=Wind shear, 9=Shock, 10=Imprisonment, 11=Imprisonment end, 12=Entanglement hit, 13=Entanglement update, 14=MCommon_Element_Entangle: OnPhase1
TargetTimeSlow: actor unit requires an explicit owned receiver; non-Caster bindings are retained for routing review
SetDynamicValueByBreakBaseDamage: not included in the visual sequence projection
DamageByAttackProperty: no literal hit animation/effect; receiver defaults are not assumed
TriggerEffect: callback target ParamEntity is a selected owned actor input, defaulting to this actor; native event payload is not assumed
ModifierAttachEffect: manual bound-effect preview; modifier flags, collider-height offset, native mutex and automatic visibility/lifetime are not applied
HideCharacterFilteredEffect: not included in the visual sequence projection
ShowEntityFloatMessage: not included in the visual sequence projection
TriggerSound: sound emitter DefaultEmitter is not the owned actor; no body or real-player substitution
ModifierOverrideOnHitEffect: owned visual receiver override only; no shield value, expiry, native modifier or automatic death/break transition
RemoveEffect: effect removal has no owned target binding
TriggerAnimState: animation has no literal owned-body binding
